name: wynajemradar-tests
description: Firestore rules tests + end-to-end test of shared lists and the admin panel on Firebase emulators (needs Java 21+).

scripts.test:rules: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../firestore.rules','firestore.rules')" && firebase emulators:exec --only firestore --project wynajemradar-test "node rules.test.js"
scripts.test:e2e: node -e "require('fs').copyFileSync('../firestore.rules','firestore.rules')" && firebase emulators:exec --only auth,firestore --project wynajemradar-test "node e2e.test.js"
